---
title: "Resources"
---

Tools and records for the risk management and insurance community. Each entry says whose work it is.

## Teaching

::: {.course-entry}
**Insurance Tycoon — a homeowners underwriting simulation**<br>
A browser-based simulation in which students price and underwrite a book of homeowners business against a live market. It runs solo for individual practice, or as an instructor-led multiplayer session in which a class competes on the same market.<br>
[[Launch the simulation](https://insurance-tycoon-production.up.railway.app/)]
:::

## The Field

::: {.course-entry}
**ARIA Academic Family Tree** · *Work in progress*<br>
Doctoral advising lineages in insurance and risk management, traced from dissertation chairs back to their root advisors. Expand a lineage, trace a name back to its root, or search for a person. The tree is James M. Carson's: he built it and presented it as the "Six Degrees of Solomon Huebner" in his ARIA presidential address. This page carries on that work.<br>
[[Explore the tree](family-tree.qmd)]
:::

::: {.course-entry}
**Risk Theory Society: Papers and Publication Outcomes** · *Work in progress*<br>
What became of the papers selected for the Risk Theory Society's annual seminar: which reached print, where, and how long it took. It also covers the meeting history, including who presided, who hosted, and how the society grew. A blank journal means no publication has been recorded, not that the paper was never published.<br>
[[View the record](rts.qmd)]
:::
